target_customer: B2B SaaS sales and partnership teams that want warm introductions through partner sales teams
problem: Sales reps lack a systematic way to request and trade warm customer introductions with partners.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for a partner introductions network

founders.name: Adam Michalski
founders.background_notes: Hosts The Partnered Podcast; steering committee of Cloud Software Association and Partnership Leaders per YC page.

founders.name: Tim Sherwood
founders.background_notes: Built social and collaboration platforms with workflow automation.

technical_complexity.rationale: A web network and workflow product with CRM integrations; mostly standard SaaS engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Value depended on partners joining the network, which gave potential network effects but early scale was small (team of two).

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Crossbeam acquired Partnered in May 2022 and folded the functionality into its platform.

market_need_then: Partner ecosystem and co-selling was a growing practice among SaaS companies, with a dedicated podcast and professional communities, but no hard demand data was found.

branding.domain_note: Held partnered.com, which now redirects to crossbeam.com.

identity.voice_and_tone: Community oriented, tied to the founder's podcast

branding.brand_signature: The Partnered Podcast hosted by the CEO
branding.community_and_virality: The founder's podcast built a following among partnership professionals; no further evidence.

brand_strength.rationale: A podcast gave some niche visibility, but the product brand was small and absorbed by Crossbeam.

outcome_analysis: Partnered was a two person team building a network for partner introductions and was acquired by Crossbeam in May 2022, announced at Crossbeam's conference, with its functionality merged into Crossbeam's platform. No funding or price is public, so it is unclear whether this was a strong exit or a soft landing; the acquirer was the category leader, which suggests the standalone network could not match its distribution.
notes: Funding search found nothing on Partnered itself, only unrelated Slow Ventures pages; investor names seen elsewhere are unverified. No 2021 dated competitor sources found; Crossbeam, Reveal and PartnerStack appear only in later comparison pages, so the list is empty. Website redirects to crossbeam.com (not fetched). Acquisition date May 18 2022 reported by Technical.ly style coverage; price undisclosed.
